name: 호버 포드(사다리꼴 지붕 윗면 + 유리 돔 캐노피 + 지붕 짐 받침대 + 짧은 옆판 + 밑 추진 빛 + 그림자)
label: sf-station/sf-pod-car

answer.evidence: The pod features a clearly foreshortened trapezoidal top/roof surface spanning rows 2 to 14 on which the glass dome canopy and roof rack are mounted, transitioning to a vertical front bumper face from rows 15 to 24.

The hover pod is drawn as a pure front elevation. The central glass dome canopy has a completely straight horizontal base (row 14) and 2D semicircle outline rather than an elliptical footprint on a receding top surface. The thrusters, bumper, and panels are all projected straight on with no foreshortened top surface visible.

The hover pod is drawn as a flat front elevation: the glass dome canopy has a completely straight flat base (row 14) and vertical semicircular arch, the roof rack at rows 0-3 is seen directly from the front on two upright posts, the lower light bar (rows 20-21) and thrusters (rows 25-26) are drawn straight-on with no horizontal top surfaces shown foreshortened.

The main body clearly depicts a top-down 3/4 view: the sloped trapezoidal roof deck spans rows 2 to 15 (~13 pixel rows) bearing a glass dome canopy and roof rack, above a visible south front face (rows 15 to 24) with light strips and underside thrusters.
